terra.problem: The text says David sought the LORD, but does not say whether he had guessed at the cause.
Saul being Israel's king before David is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The passage says David sought the face of the LORD; it does not give a direct question from David.
Saul being Israel's king before David needs a reference.
Saul being Israel's king before David needs a reference.
It gives the Gibeonites having been hurt as the reason David lets them speak. The text does not state that reason.
David agrees in verse 6, but he does not hand the men over until verse 9. Saying he follows through here blurs that distinction.
The quoted words in 1 Samuel 20:42 are spoken by Jonathan, not by both men.
The text says Rizpah spread sackcloth on a rock; it does not say she sat on it the whole time.
The text does not say how long Rizpah's watch lasted or that she stayed in one place throughout it.
The text does not establish how long it was before the rain came.
Saul being Israel's king before David needs a reference.
Saying Saul and Jonathan went home to the tomb implies Zela was their home; the passage does not say that.
